description: The widget windows (Map, Cube Finder) move themselves (Minimap.tsx startMove: outerPosition + setPosition), so Windows can't snap them to a screen edge, and let the mouse through while they step aside for a game menu (MapExplorer.tsx). The Black Market panel (petmarket) moves the same way and takes the mouse only while it shows (BlackMarket.tsx), as does the event popup (eventpop, EventPopup.tsx).
